name: Gross margin
explain: Share of each sales dollar left after direct production costs. Signals pricing power.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Operating (EBIT) margin
explain: Profit from core operations before financing and taxes.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: EBITDA margin
explain: Operating profit before non-cash D&A; a rough proxy for operating cash generation.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Pre-tax margin
explain: Profit after interest and all operating items, before taxes.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Net profit margin
explain: Bottom-line profit per dollar of revenue.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: R&D intensity
explain: How much of revenue is reinvested in research. Not good or bad on its own.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: SG&A to revenue
explain: Overhead burden. Rising SG&A/revenue can signal falling operating leverage.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Effective tax rate
explain: Taxes actually expensed as a share of pre-tax profit.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Return on assets (ROA)
explain: Profit generated by every dollar of assets, regardless of how they are financed.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Return on equity (ROE)
explain: Return earned for shareholders. Blank when average equity is negative (e.g. heavy buybacks).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Return on tangible equity
explain: ROE stripping out acquisition goodwill; widely used for banks.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Return on invested capital (ROIC)
formula: EBIT x (1 - tax rate) / Average (debt + equity)
explain: After-tax operating return on all capital provided by lenders and shareholders. Compare to WACC.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Return on capital employed (ROCE)
explain: Pre-tax operating return on long-term capital.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Debt-to-equity
explain: Financial leverage from borrowing. Blank when equity is negative.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Debt-to-assets
explain: Share of assets funded by interest-bearing debt.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Debt-to-capital
explain: Debt as a share of the total capital base.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Liabilities-to-assets
explain: All obligations (not just debt) as a share of assets.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Financial leverage (equity multiplier)
explain: Assets supported by each dollar of equity; the leverage leg of DuPont.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Net debt / EBITDA
explain: Years of EBITDA needed to repay net debt. Negative = net cash.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Interest coverage
explain: How many times operating profit covers interest. Below ~3x deserves attention.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: CFO to debt
explain: Share of debt that one year of operating cash flow could repay.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Current ratio
explain: Ability to meet short-term obligations with short-term assets.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Quick ratio
explain: Stricter liquidity test that excludes inventory.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Cash ratio
explain: Most conservative liquidity ratio.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Operating cash-flow ratio
explain: Short-term obligations covered by a year's operating cash flow.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Total asset turnover
explain: Revenue generated per dollar of assets; the efficiency leg of DuPont.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Fixed-asset turnover
explain: Revenue per dollar of plant and equipment.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Receivables turnover
explain: How many times per year receivables are collected.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Days sales outstanding (DSO)
explain: Average days to collect cash from customers.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Inventory turnover
explain: How many times inventory is sold and replaced per year.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Days inventory on hand (DOH)
explain: Average days inventory sits before it is sold.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Payables turnover
explain: How many times per year suppliers are paid (CFA uses purchases; COGS is the usual proxy).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Days payables outstanding (DPO)
explain: Average days taken to pay suppliers.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Cash conversion cycle
explain: Days between paying suppliers and collecting from customers. Negative is a funding advantage.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Working-capital turnover
explain: Revenue per dollar of working capital. Blank when working capital is negative.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Free-cash-flow margin
explain: Cash left for owners per revenue dollar.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows

name: Cash conversion (CFO / NI)
explain: Earnings quality check: consistently below 1 means profits are not turning into cash.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows

name: Capex intensity
explain: How capital-hungry the business is.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows

name: Capex / D&A
explain: >1 means the asset base is growing; <1 for long periods can mean under-investment.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows

name: Stock comp / revenue
explain: Non-cash pay that dilutes shareholders and flatters CFO.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows

name: Accruals ratio (cash-flow basis)
formula: (Net income - CFO - CFI) / Average total assets
explain: Share of earnings not backed by cash. High accruals predict weaker future earnings (Sloan).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Analyzing Statements of Cash Flows

name: Revenue growth (YoY)
explain: Top-line growth.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Net income growth (YoY)
explain: Bottom-line growth.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Diluted EPS growth (YoY)
explain: Per-share earnings growth (includes buyback effects).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: CFO growth (YoY)
explain: Operating cash-flow growth; compare with NI growth.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Total asset growth (YoY)
explain: Balance-sheet expansion.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Dividend payout ratio
explain: Share of earnings paid out as dividends.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Total payout ratio
explain: All cash returned to shareholders relative to earnings.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Retention ratio (b)
explain: Share of earnings kept in the business.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Sustainable growth rate
explain: Growth the firm can fund without new equity or more leverage (CFA: g = b x ROE).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Book value per share
explain: Accounting net worth per share.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Change in diluted shares
explain: Negative = buybacks shrinking the share count; positive = dilution.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: DuPont: net profit margin
explain: Profitability leg.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: DuPont: asset turnover
explain: Efficiency leg.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: DuPont: equity multiplier
explain: Leverage leg.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: DuPont: tax burden
explain: Share of pre-tax profit kept after tax (5-step).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: DuPont: interest burden
explain: Share of EBIT left after interest (5-step).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: DuPont: EBIT margin
explain: Operating profitability leg (5-step).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA: Financial Analysis Techniques

name: Net interest income / avg assets (NIM proxy)
formula: Net interest income / Average total assets
explain: True NIM uses earning assets; total assets is a close public-data proxy.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Efficiency ratio
explain: Cost to earn one dollar of revenue. Lower is better; ~55-60% is typical for large banks.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Non-interest income share
explain: Reliance on fees and trading vs. lending spread.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Loan-to-deposit ratio
explain: Funding/liquidity balance. Very high = reliant on wholesale funding.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Credit cost (provision / avg loans)
formula: Provision for credit losses / Average loans
explain: Annual credit losses being reserved.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Allowance / loans
formula: Allowance for loan losses / Net loans
explain: Reserve cushion against future defaults.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Equity / assets
explain: Simple capital-adequacy proxy (not regulatory CET1).
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Loss ratio
explain: Share of premiums paid out in claims.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions

name: Premiums / revenue
explain: How much of the group is insurance.
cfa_reading: CFA L1 FSA/Equity: Analysis of Financial Institutions
